recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7160 unless OO separately decides to add or restore a current USLab-style example, which would be a new example-scope decision rather than unfinished application of this DSTU1 clarification.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO clarification from the 2015 May ballot asking for more explanation of Observation grouping and panels in component and related descriptions, plus Observation notes and example references such as blood pressure and USLab.
initial_application: Historical commits 6909eeca50 and d4505c43ef applied the request by adding and reorganizing Observation grouping notes; d4505c43ef explicitly lists 7160 in its subject. The same 2015 Observation change family included FHIR-7517/FHIR-7639 work that reintroduced Observation.component and clarified component-versus-member relationships.
additional_context: Observation remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later final decisions replaced Observation.related with explicit hasMember and derivedFrom elements (FHIR-10118), added Observation.organizer for groupers (FHIR-50138), and refined diagnostics-module grouping wording (FHIR-50635). The old USLab IG reference is not active in the current core build because source/igs.xml comments out the USLab IG entry.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Observation notes and definitions already explain grouping through DiagnosticReport.result, Observation.component, Observation.hasMember, Observation.derivedFrom, and organizer, and point to current examples such as blood pressure, BMI, Apgar, lipid/vital panels, and diagnostics guidance.

related_jiras.note: Reintroduced Observation.component, supplying the component side of the grouping explanation requested by FHIR-7160.

Refined diagnostics-module wording around relationships necessary for interpretation.
